mechanism.claim: A completed high-variation eight-hour BTC block whose first- and second-half one-minute return distributions have an unusually large two-sample empirical-CDF distance marks an intraday regime migration. When the full block and second half agree in direction, follow the newly established regime for eight hours.
mechanism.side: common strict sign of completed eight-hour and second-four-hour returns
mechanism.why_distinct: HVIDBR uses the Kolmogorov-Smirnov supremum distance between all 240 raw one-minute open-to-close returns in each half. Temporal variance ignition compares second moments; realized skew and kurtosis compress one full block into moments; change-point candidates fit a location break; time-price fit uses price levels. HVIDBR uses no flow, volume, funding, OI, cross-assets, prior events, fitted labels, or controls.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the causal variation tail selects volatile blocks while a large distributional break separates an evolving return law from stationary high-volatility churn
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: three fixed UTC empirical-CDF-break onsets with eight-hour reservation are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.block: 480 exact coherent BTCUSDT bars_binance interval=1m rows [D-8h,D)
features.minute_return: log(close/open) for each completed one-minute bar
features.halves: first 240 and final 240 minute returns, fixed by timestamp
features.ks_distance: supremum absolute difference between the two empirical CDFs over their pooled finite support
features.distribution_break_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.75
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared minute returns), strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.block_return: log(last close/first open) over eight hours
features.late_return: log(last close/open at D-4h) over the second four hours
features.direction_confirmation: block and late returns have one strict nonzero sign
features.onset: eligible now and immediately prior exact valid block ineligible; missing prior opportunity cannot trigger

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no distribution statistic, rank, side, hold, clock, subset, or control repair.
